# feat(perf): weight report of a draft render for the cost meter

<!-- bogd3v/micelio#730 as read with gh issue view on 2026-10-24: the input of micelio-730.md -->

Part of bogd3v/micelio-plugin-core#62.

## Why

The cost meter (decision: a block over budget is refused at publish) needs the real weight of a page as the visitor would download it, measured by the frontend, which is the only renderer. `npm run perf` measures built pages in CI; nothing measures one draft on demand.

## What to build

- `server/api/preview/[uid]/[documentId]/weight.get.ts`, same token as the preview route: renders the draft in both modes and answers `{ data: { mode, htmlKb, cssKb, jsKb, imagesKb, totalKb, onDemandKb, blocks: [{ id, kb, onDemandKb }] } }`, reusing the measurement of `scripts/perf/` (extract it to `app/helpers/weight.ts` if it is not pure yet).
- `onDemandKb` is the script an island loads only on request (ADR-0018 `cost`), reported apart and never added to `totalKb`.
- `docs/performance.md`: how the on-demand measurement relates to the CI budgets.

## Requirements

- The report is computed, never estimated; a block's share is the difference with and without it, cached per document version for 5 minutes.
- No change to public routes; the route carries the same headers as the preview route.
- `feat` → MINOR.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Unit tests of the measurement helper on fixtures (a page with three blocks, one island).
- [ ] Integration: the report of the seeded landing equals the CI measurement of the same page within 2 %.
- [ ] The route answers within 3 s for a ten-block page on the dev container.
- [ ] Verified by the maintainer on the frontend image built from the branch (`docker build`), run against the plugin's Docker Compose, following the steps the PR lists under Tests.

The maintainer reviews the whole diff before merging (standard, sections 11 and 13).
